mapper.select: SELECT f.fav_id AS favId, f.place_id AS placeId, p.title, p.SEASON_NOTE AS summary, ps.SEASON_TYPE AS seasonType, p.LIST_IMG AS listImg, f.created_at AS createdAt FROM FAVORITES f JOIN PLACES p ON f.place_id = p.PLACE_ID JOIN PLACE_SEASONS ps ON p.PLACE_ID = ps.PLACE_ID WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO FAVORITES (FAV_ID, USER_ID, PLACE_ID, CREATED_AT) VALUES (FAV_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{userId}, #{placeId}, SYSDATE)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM FAVORITES WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND place_id = #{placeId}
